scripts.postinstall: if git rev-parse --git-dir >/dev/null 2>&1; then lefthook install; fi
scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others --names mock,web "bun run api:mock" "bun run --filter web dev"
scripts.check: biome check . && bun run typecheck && bun run test && bun run build && bun run contracts:lint && bun run check:design
scripts.contracts:stale: bun run contracts:gen && git status --porcelain --untracked-files=all -- packages/contracts/src/gen | (! grep .)
scripts.db:migrate: if ls db/migrations/*.sql >/dev/null 2>&1; then dbmate --no-dump-schema up; else echo 'No migrations in db/migrations, nothing to apply.'; fi
